question_set.question: Use sort_bars with order equal to descending to position the bars by the mean of action across different platforms in order to know what is the position of each platform by the mean of action?

answer.value: Group E has the highest average math scores across most parental education levels, while Group A has the lowest. Students with parents having master degree consistently show the highest scores regardless of race/ethnicity, indicating both race/ethnicity and parental education level influence math performance

key_insights: Group E has highest average math scores
Group A has lowest average math scores
Master degree parents have highest scores
Parental education level strongly impacts math performance

reasoning_trace.rationale: Sort bars in descending order to analyze math score patterns across race/ethnicity groups and parental education levels
